items.label: Asked the medications — found the two antiplatelets
Asked what came up, and what came out
Read the shock off his hands and eyes
Two large-bore lines inside four minutes
The access never lagged the shock
Blood on the pole, not just salt water
Called GI — endoscopy is the source control
Never fed aspirin to a bleeding stomach
Named it — an upper GI bleed
Resuscitated, scoped, alive — the ICU takes him
